surface_mechanism_description: The surface reaction mechanism involves the oxidation of the Si surface using O2 plasma during PEALD, which forms a stable SiOx layer and an interfacial oxide layer. The hysteresis reduction and flat band voltage shift are attributed to defect passivation by H diffusing out from SiNx:H.
evidence: The hysteresis value was minimized to about 2 V when more than 100 W of plasma power was applied during oxidation, which provides a formation of a high quality interfacial oxide layer. Moreover, by post-annealing at 200 /C176C without a plasma application, flat band voltage was shifted to near 1.2 V, which may be attributed to defect passivation by H diffusing out from SiN x:H.
